## Background

Parent roadmap: #2742

`kurone-kito/template#30` (template commit `5c93ea22`) updated the
Contributor Covenant files. Repository rules forbid modifying
community documents (`CODE_OF_CONDUCT*`, `CONTRIBUTING*`) without
explicit approval. This issue is that approval gate. It does not
itself edit those files.

In scope for the sibling implementation issue, once approved:

- English `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` is already 3.0 here; the
  remaining delta is the reporting channel (local: GitHub issues or
  mention on X; template: private email `krone@kit.black`).
- Japanese `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.ja.md` is still the older 2.x-style
  text; the template has a full 3.0 rewrite.
- Chinese `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.zh.md` needs the 3.0 numbered-list
  alignment. Its title stays `贡献者公约`.

Out of scope: `CONTRIBUTING*` (community docs, and the local extra
"Local development tooling" section is IDD-specific).

## Required action

A maintainer with authority to change community documents should reply
on this issue with an explicit approval (or an explicit decline) to
edit `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.ja.md`, and
`.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.zh.md` only.

If the reporting-channel change should differ from the template
default (`krone@kit.black` in all three files), say so in that reply.

## Ready signal

Close this issue after posting the approval or decline.

- Approval unblocks the implementation issue.
- Decline must say so clearly, and the implementation issue should
  then be closed as not planned rather than executed.
